fixed_cache: Use stored decompositions and original rewrites per old set. Identity rewrite for new questions matches main.
stop: One policy and one combined evaluation; do not tune using scores. Keep feature opt-in if any gate fails.

policy.name: source_scoped_single_round
policy.trigger: At least two explicitly named papers; a subquestion has fewer than two source-matched local Top-3 passages selected, or a requested-paper global Top-10 passage was excluded. These are coverage heuristics, not semantic sufficiency.
policy.paper_identity: Unique aliases derived only from titles/source names: leading title label, full title and 2-4-word initialisms; do not match RAG inside Self-RAG or RAG-Token. No hand-coded paper names or Gold.
policy.supplement: For at most four affected tasks, retrieve Dense and BM25 scoped to that paper (60 each), fuse to 60, retain first-pass candidates, and rerank source-matched task candidates. No second round.
policy.selection: Reserve original-query global first half of budget, then original RRF first hit and each source-matched task first hit, fill remaining slots globally. Return original-query global order.
policy.global_scores: Reuse first-pass original-query Cross-Encoder scores; score only new IDs with that same query/model. Never compare scores from different subquestions.
policy.timing: Report measured completion overhead and evaluation retrieval time; ratio is an evaluation cost proxy, not production latency or P95.
